vocabulary_groups.title: Garment category words
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for grouping garments in simple Fashion Design English.

items.definition_en: A piece of clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A clothing item or piece of clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: This garment is simple and comfortable.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peça de roupa é simples e confortável.
items.professional_context_en: Fashion Design students use garment as a professional word for clothing items.
items.professional_context_pt: Estudantes de Design de Moda usam garment como palavra profissional para peças de roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é peça de roupa.

items.definition_en: A garment worn on the upper part of the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A clothing item for the upper body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça de roupa para a parte de cima do corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: This blouse is a top.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta blusa é uma peça da parte de cima.
items.professional_context_en: Top helps students classify garments in sketches, boards, and descriptions.
items.professional_context_pt: Top ajuda os alunos a classificar roupas em croquis, painéis e descrições.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais natural é parte de cima.

items.definition_en: A garment worn on the lower part of the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A clothing item for the lower body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça de roupa para a parte de baixo do corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: These pants are a bottom.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta calça é uma peça da parte de baixo.
items.professional_context_en: Bottom supports simple garment sorting in design classes.
items.professional_context_pt: Bottom ajuda na organização simples de roupas nas aulas de design.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais natural é parte de baixo.

items.definition_en: Clothing worn over other clothes.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Clothing you wear over other clothes.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Roupa usada por cima de outras roupas.
items.example_sentence_en: A coat is outerwear.
items.example_sentence_pt: Um casaco é uma peça de sobreposição.
items.professional_context_en: Outerwear is useful for classifying coats, jackets, and blazers in fashion study.
items.professional_context_pt: Outerwear é útil para classificar casacos, jaquetas e blazers no estudo de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: Pode ser explicado como peça de sobreposição.

items.definition_en: A full set of clothes worn together.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A complete look with clothes together.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um conjunto completo de roupas usadas juntas.
items.example_sentence_en: This outfit is casual.
items.example_sentence_pt: Este conjunto é casual.
items.professional_context_en: Outfit helps learners describe a complete look instead of one garment only.
items.professional_context_pt: Outfit ajuda os alunos a descrever um look completo, e não apenas uma peça.
items.translation_notes_pt: Pode ser traduzido como conjunto ou look.

vocabulary_groups.title: Tops and upper garments
vocabulary_groups.description: Common upper-body garments learners can recognize and name in simple English.

items.definition_en: A casual short-sleeved shirt.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A casual shirt, often with short sleeves.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma camiseta casual, geralmente com mangas curtas.
items.example_sentence_en: This T-shirt is blue.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta camiseta é azul.
items.professional_context_en: T-shirt is a high-frequency garment word for visual identification and styling talk.
items.professional_context_pt: T-shirt é uma palavra de roupa muito frequente para identificação visual e conversa sobre estilo.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é camiseta.

items.definition_en: A garment for the upper body, often with a collar and buttons.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A top that often has a collar and buttons.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça da parte de cima que geralmente tem gola e botões.
items.example_sentence_en: This shirt has buttons.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta camisa tem botões.
items.professional_context_en: Shirt supports feature language such as collar, buttons, and sleeves.
items.professional_context_pt: Shirt ajuda com linguagem de características, como gola, botões e mangas.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução direta é camisa.

items.definition_en: A light upper-body garment, often worn as a more formal top.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A light top, often more formal than a T-shirt.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça leve da parte de cima, muitas vezes mais formal que uma camiseta.
items.example_sentence_en: This blouse is formal.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta blusa é formal.
items.professional_context_en: Blouse helps learners talk about garment style and occasion.
items.professional_context_pt: Blouse ajuda os alunos a falar sobre estilo de roupa e ocasião.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é blusa.

items.definition_en: A warm knitted garment for the upper body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A warm top for cool or cold weather.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peça quente para a parte de cima, usada em clima fresco ou frio.
items.example_sentence_en: This sweater is comfortable.

weeks.lesson_plan_markdown:
# Week 3: Garments and Categories

## Overview
Week 3 shifts the focus from studio tools to the garments Fashion Design students actually draw, organize, sew, describe, and later critique. The week stays highly visual and A2-first. Students begin with a fast visual opener, learn a core garment set through picture vocabulary and category sorting, read and listen to short garment descriptions, practice reliable sentence frames, build a scaffolded Garment ID Card, review one correction target, and then present one garment in a teacher-led speaking session.

The instructional sequence keeps the same recognizable rhythm as Weeks 1 and 2: recognition before production, structured support before teacher-reviewed writing, and written support before speaking. The Garment ID Card is the week’s main artifact, but it remains controlled and frame-based rather than paragraph-based.

## Learning Objectives
- Recognize and name common garments in English.
- Sort garments into simple categories such as tops, bottoms, one-piece garments, outerwear, and outfit or look.
- Understand short A2-level written and spoken garment descriptions.
- Use sentence frames such as `This is a ___`, `These are ___`, `It has ___`, `They have ___`, and `It is for ___`.
- Build a short Garment ID Card from sentence frames instead of writing an open paragraph from scratch.
- Revise one sentence focused on articles, plural garment forms, or missing noun-phrase elements.
- Say 4-6 short garment-description sentences during the teacher session.

## Professional Fashion-Design Context
Garment vocabulary is central to Fashion Design study. Students need this language to talk about sketches, references, silhouettes, wardrobe categories, classroom examples, styling decisions, and later design critique. Week 3 begins that process with practical, visible, reusable language rather than abstract fashion commentary.

The tasks are designed for adult learners in a fashion-studies context. Even at A2 level, students are naming garments, explaining simple features, and using clear category language that will matter again in later weeks about garment parts, textile choices, and design presentation.

## Language Objectives
- Name garments such as `T-shirt`, `shirt`, `blouse`, `sweater`, `hoodie`, `skirt`, `pants`, `shorts`, `jeans`, `dress`, `jumpsuit`, `jacket`, `coat`, and `blazer`.
- Use category language such as `top`, `bottom`, `outerwear`, `garment`, `outfit`, and `look`.
- Describe garments with short adjectives such as `casual`, `formal`, and `comfortable`.
- Name simple garment features such as `collar`, `buttons`, `zipper`, `pockets`, `short sleeves`, and `long sleeves`.
- Use singular and plural garment frames more accurately, especially with `pants`, `jeans`, and `shorts`.
- Connect garment description to use or occasion with phrases such as `for class`, `for work`, `for hot weather`, and `for cold weather`.

## Materials Needed
- One garment overview image board for the opener.
- Two to three garment vocabulary boards grouped by category.
- One reading board or image set for the three garment descriptions.
- One short garment-description audio clip or teacher read-aloud fallback.
- Sentence frames for singular and plural garment description.
- Student writing space for the Week 3 Garment ID Card.
- Optional garment image cards for teacher-led category sorting and live speaking support.

## Suggested Sequence
1. `m01w03-a01` Welcome Back: students identify common garments from a visual board.
2. `m01w03-a02` Garment Vocabulary: students match garment images to English names and sort them by category.
3. `m01w03-a03` Read: students match three short garment descriptions to the correct images and answer detail questions.
4. `m01w03-a04` Listen: students hear four short garment descriptions and choose the correct garment, feature, or category.
5. `m01w03-a05` Phrase Practice: students complete and correct controlled garment-description frames.
6. `m01w03-a06` Create a Garment ID Card: students build a short structured garment description from sentence frames.
7. `m01w03-a07` Review and Improve: students correct one common Week 3 sentence problem.
8. `m01w03-a08` Teacher Session: students pronounce garment words, sort live image cards, and present one garment.

## Timing Estimate
- `m01w03-a01` 6 minutes
- `m01w03-a02` 14 minutes
- `m01w03-a03` 12 minutes
- `m01w03-a04` 12 minutes
- `m01w03-a05` 10 minutes
- `m01w03-a06` 18 minutes
- `m01w03-a07` 7 minutes
- `m01w03-a08` 50 minutes

Total planned time: 129 minutes.

The asynchronous or app-style portion is 79 minutes. The teacher-led speaking session is 50 minutes.

## Differentiation Options
- Keep garment boards visible during vocabulary, reading, listening, and writing.
- Let learners who need more support choose from reduced word banks before completing sentence frames.
- Allow students to select either a singular garment or a plural garment for the Garment ID Card based on confidence.
- Provide one completed model frame beside the writing task for learners who need stronger support.
- Allow pair rehearsal with notes before the teacher-observed speaking task.

## Extension Options
- Ask stronger learners to add one optional challenge sentence explaining why a garment is useful, modern, or appropriate for a situation.
- Invite students to compare two garments briefly with a sentence such as `The blazer is formal, but the hoodie is casual`.
- During the teacher session, ask confident learners one follow-up question about use, weather, or category.

## Notes for Future App Implementation
Week 3 maps cleanly to a visual-first mobile flow. The app-facing design should preserve:

- one reusable garment overview board for the opener
- category-based image-word matching boards saved as the main checked output
- a reading board with short texts and image matching rather than long reading passages
- audio replay for the listening task with transcript reveal only after an attempt
- sentence-frame writing fields for the Garment ID Card instead of one large blank text box
- a teacher-visible structured writing submission with revision support
- a teacher-observed speaking checkpoint that tracks completion without recording audio

The garment set introduced this week should remain reusable in later weeks about garment parts, silhouettes, fabrics, styling, and simple critique.
weeks.teacher_notes_markdown:
# Teacher Notes: Week 3 - Garments and Categories

## Common Learner Difficulties
Students may confuse similar garment categories, especially `dress` and `skirt`, `jacket` and `blazer`, or `shirt` and `blouse`. They may also overuse singular frames with plural garments, producing sentences like `This are jeans` or `It has pockets` when the garment is plural. Another frequent issue is dropping articles in singular descriptions such as `This is dress` or writing too little in the Garment ID Card to show category, features, and use clearly.

## Classroom Management Suggestions
Keep the week highly visual and sequenced from recognition to production. Let students identify and sort garments before asking them to describe anything. During the Garment ID Card task, display the required sentence frames where everyone can see them and encourage students to complete one line at a time instead of trying to write freely. In the teacher speaking session, allow students to hold their card and use it as a speaking guide.

## Professional Context Notes
Keep examples connected to real Fashion Design study rather than general shopping language. Students should use garment words to talk about what they sketch, classify, present, and discuss in class. The week is not about fashion opinions only; it is about building a basic technical vocabulary for visible clothing categories, simple features, and use or occasion.

## Cultural or Industry Notes
Some learners may already know international fashion words such as `look`, `blazer`, or `cardigan`, but they may not use them accurately in English sentences. Treat those words as useful bridges, while still modeling clear beginner grammar. It is also helpful to note that `pants` is the main production target for this course, while `trousers` is included mainly as a recognition variant students may see in other English materials.

## Simplify This Week
Reduce the Garment ID Card to exactly five required lines:
- This is a ___ / These are ___.
- It is a ___ / They are ___.
- It has ___ / They have ___.
- It is for ___ / They are for ___.
- I like it because ___ / I like them because ___.

For reading and listening, keep answer choices visible during the first pass. In the speaking task, accept 3 to 4 short spoken sentences with teacher prompting if needed.

## Extend This Week
Ask stronger learners to add the optional challenge line comparing one garment to another, or to add one extra feature phrase such as `It has short sleeves and buttons`. In the teacher session, invite a short follow-up question about weather, occasion, or whether the garment is casual or formal.

## Asynchronous or App-Based Adaptation
The opener, vocabulary matching, reading, listening, phrase practice, and correction task can all be app-checked with immediate feedback. The Garment ID Card should remain teacher-visible because it is the week's main structured writing artifact and may need revision support. The speaking checkpoint should remain teacher-observed and non-recorded, with the app serving only to display prompts, sentence frames, garment images, and completion notes.

The teacher should check task completion, accurate garment-part vocabulary, use of at least one location phrase, and one understandable comment sentence. If revision is needed, ask the student to fix one sentence or add one missing detail line.

input.prompt_en: Choose one garment and complete the Garment Details Card.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma peça e complete o Cartão de Detalhes da Peça.

items.label_pt: Escolha a sua peça.
Linhas obrigatórias
items.prompt_en: Complete the 5 required lines. Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
items.prompt_pt: Complete as 5 linhas obrigatórias. Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se quiser prática extra.
required_lines_en: There is a ___ on the ___ / There are ___ on the ___.
The ___ is at the ___ / There are ___ near the ___.
required_lines_pt: There is a ___ on the ___ / There are ___ on the ___.
The ___ is at the ___ / There are ___ near the ___.

items.optional_challenge_pt: One detail is decorative or functional because ___.

steps.title: Choose one garment card
steps.student_action_en: Choose one garment from the card set and look at its visible details.

steps.title: Complete the required lines

steps.student_action_pt: Complete o Cartão de Detalhes da Peça, uma linha por vez, usando as frases-modelo.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the writing structured and prevent students from turning the task into an unsupported paragraph.

steps.title: Review one detail sentence
steps.student_action_en: Read your lines again and check the detail words and location phrases.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia as suas linhas novamente e confira as palavras de detalhe e as frases de localização.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to fix one missing article, plural noun, or location phrase before submission.

expected_output.description_en: A teacher-reviewed Garment Details Card with 5 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.
expected_output.description_pt: Um Cartão de Detalhes da Peça revisado pelo professor, com 5 linhas obrigatórias de frases-modelo e 1 linha opcional de desafio.

completion_criteria_en: The student names one garment clearly.

completion_criteria_pt: O aluno nomeia uma peça com clareza.

rubric.excellent_en: All required lines are complete and clearly connected to one garment.
rubric.excellent_pt: Todas as linhas obrigatórias estão completas e claramente ligadas a uma peça.

rubric.needs_work_pt: Várias linhas obrigatórias estão faltando ou não estão claras.

rubric.excellent_en: The student uses Week 4 detail words accurately.
rubric.excellent_pt: O aluno usa as palavras de detalhe da Semana 4 com precisão.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The student uses some accurate Week 4 detail words with minor errors.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O aluno usa algumas palavras corretas de detalhe da Semana 4, com pequenos erros.
rubric.needs_work_en: The detail words are missing, too broad, or often inaccurate.
rubric.needs_work_pt: As palavras de detalhe estão ausentes, amplas demais ou frequentemente incorretas.

rubric.excellent_en: The student uses It has or There is or There are and one location phrase correctly.
rubric.excellent_pt: O aluno usa It has ou There is ou There are e uma frase de localização corretamente.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The student uses the target phrases with some support or one small error.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O aluno usa as frases-alvo com algum apoio ou um pequeno erro.
rubric.needs_work_en: The target phrases are missing or often incorrect.
rubric.needs_work_pt: As frases-alvo estão ausentes ou frequentemente incorretas.

rubric.excellent_en: The meaning is clear and easy for the teacher to understand.
rubric.excellent_pt: O sentido está claro e fácil para o professor entender.
rubric.satisfactory_en: The meaning is mostly clear with small language problems.
rubric.satisfactory_pt: O sentido está quase sempre claro, com pequenos problemas de linguagem.

assessment.model_response_en: This is a black jacket. It has long sleeves, a zipper, and two pockets. There is a zipper on the front. The hem is at the bottom. I like this detail because it is functional. One detail is simple because the collar is small.
assessment.model_response_pt: Esta é uma jaqueta preta. Ela tem mangas compridas, um zíper e dois bolsos. Há um zíper na frente. A bainha fica na parte de baixo. Eu gosto desse detalhe porque ele é funcional. Um detalhe é simples porque a gola é pequena.
common_errors: Using a broad garment sentence with no specific detail vocabulary.
Writing There is buttons instead of There are buttons.
Using in the front or in the bottom instead of on the front or at the bottom.
feedback_prompts_en: Add one clearer Week 4 detail word.
Check one singular or plural noun in your lines.
Fix one location phrase and submit again.
feedback_prompts_pt: Acrescente uma palavra de detalhe da Semana 4 mais clara.
Confira um substantivo no singular ou no plural nas suas linhas.
Corrija uma frase de localização e envie novamente.

support: Allow students to complete exactly five lines with a visible word bank and one model line.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add the optional challenge line using decorative or functional.

extension_options: Turn one line from the card into a speaking note for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a teacher-reviewed structured writing card with one garment-choice step and separate line fields saved as one submission. Keep the base task to 5 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line. The teacher view should show the selected garment, the completed lines, a checklist, the rubric, quick feedback prompts, and a return-for-revision option for one targeted correction.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Singular, Plural, and Location
activities.summary: Students review one common Week 4 sentence problem and save one corrected version they can transfer into their Garment Details Card.

en.title: Review and Improve: Singular, Plural, and Location
en.summary: Choose one correction card and write the improved sentence.
en.instructions: Choose one correction card, notice the problem, and write the corrected sentence clearly.
success_criteria: I can notice one common Week 4 sentence problem.
I can write one corrected sentence clearly.
I can use the correction to improve my own detail card.

pt.title: Revise e melhore: singular, plural e localização
pt.summary: Escolha um cartão de correção e escreva a frase melhorada.
pt.instructions: Escolha um cartão de correção, perceba o problema e escreva a frase corrigida com clareza.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um problema comum de frase da Semana 4.

Eu consigo usar a correção para melhorar o meu próprio cartão de detalhes.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the correction target narrow and transferable. Students should save one corrected sentence and then check whether the same problem appears in their own writing.

input.prompt_en: Choose one Week 4 sentence and write the corrected version.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma frase da Semana 4 e escreva a versão corrigida.

items.label_pt: Corrija a falta de artigo.
Corrija o substantivo no plural.

items.label_en: Correct the there is or there are phrase.
items.label_pt: Corrija a frase com there is ou there are.
items.incorrect_sentence: There is buttons on the front.
items.correct_sentence: There are buttons on the front.
accepted_answers: There are buttons on the front.

items.label_pt: Corrija a frase de localização.
items.incorrect_sentence: The hem is in the bottom.
items.correct_sentence: The hem is at the bottom.
accepted_answers: The hem is at the bottom.

steps.title: Choose a correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read one incorrect sentence and notice the Week 4 correction focus.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia uma frase incorreta e perceba o foco de correção da Semana 4.
steps.teacher_action: Name the common targets clearly: article, plural noun, there is or there are, and location phrase.

steps.title: Write the corrected sentence
steps.student_action_en: Rewrite the sentence clearly and accurately.
steps.student_action_pt: Reescreva a frase com clareza e precisão.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to compare the corrected sentence with their own Garment Details Card.

steps.title: Transfer the correction
steps.student_action_en: Check whether the same problem appears in your own writing.
steps.student_action_pt: Confira se o mesmo problema aparece na sua própria escrita.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to fix the same issue in their own card if needed.

expected_output.description_en: One corrected Week 4 sentence saved after review.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma frase corrigida da Semana 4 salva após a revisão.

completion_criteria_en: The student chooses one correction card.
The student writes the corrected sentence accurately.
The student checks whether the same issue appears in personal writing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno escolhe um cartão de correção.
O aluno escreve a frase corrigida com precisão.
O aluno verifica se o mesmo problema aparece na escrita pessoal.
checklist_en: I chose one correction card.
I wrote the corrected sentence.
I checked my own detail card for the same problem.
checklist_pt: Eu escolhi um cartão de correção.

Eu conferi o meu próprio cartão de detalhes para ver o mesmo problema.
assessment.model_response_en: There are buttons on the front.
assessment.model_response_pt: Há botões na frente.
common_errors: Keeping the original mistake in the new sentence.
Fixing the noun but not the location phrase or article.
feedback_prompts_en: Look at the noun again. Does the sentence need one detail or more than one detail?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe o substantivo novamente. A frase precisa de um detalhe ou de mais de um detalhe?

support: Limit the choice to two correction cards for students who need more support.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain the correction rule in simple English or Portuguese.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a small correction-card activity with four common Week 4 sentence problems. Let the student choose one card, type or select the corrected version, and compare against accepted answers. Save one corrected sentence as the Week 4 mini-revision artifact.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Explain the Details
activities.summary: Students use their Week 4 Garment Details Card to pronounce garment-part vocabulary, label details live, and explain one garment in short supported sentences.

en.title: Teacher Session: Explain the Details
en.summary: Use your detail card to explain one garment in short sentences.
en.instructions: Bring your Garment Details Card, practice the key detail words, and explain one garment in 4 to 6 short sentences.
success_criteria: I can name one garment and several details clearly.
I can use one location phrase while speaking.
I can explain one garment with teacher support.

Eu consigo usar uma frase de localização enquanto falo.
Eu consigo explicar uma peça com apoio do professor.

activities.teacher_instructions: Use the live session to move Week 4 detail language from structured writing into supported speaking. Do not record student audio. Focus on intelligibility, accurate detail words, one clear location phrase, and student confidence with notes.

input.prompt_en: Use your Garment Details Card to explain one garment in short sentences.

items.label_pt: Inclua uma frase de localização e uma frase de comentário.

steps.title: Pronunciation clinic

steps.title: Label details live

vocabulary_groups.title: Upper garment parts and orientation
vocabulary_groups.description: Core visible upper-garment parts students need for beginner description and labeling.

items.definition_en: The part around the neck of some shirts, jackets, or coats.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The neck part on some garments.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do pescoço em algumas peças de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The shirt has a collar.
items.example_sentence_pt: A camisa tem gola.
items.professional_context_en: Students use collar to label and describe visible shirt and jacket details.
items.professional_context_pt: Os alunos usam collar para rotular e descrever detalhes visíveis de camisas e jaquetas.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é gola.

items.definition_en: The shape or opening around the neck of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The opening around the neck of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A abertura ao redor do pescoço da peça.
items.example_sentence_en: The dress has a round neckline.
items.example_sentence_pt: O vestido tem decote redondo.
items.professional_context_en: Neckline helps students describe dresses, blouses, and design details more precisely.
items.professional_context_pt: Neckline ajuda os alunos a descrever vestidos, blusas e detalhes de design com mais precisão.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é decote.

items.definition_en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The arm part of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da peça que cobre o braço.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket has long sleeves.
items.example_sentence_pt: A jaqueta tem mangas compridas.
items.professional_context_en: Sleeve is one of the most useful Week 4 detail words for labeling and speaking.
items.professional_context_pt: Sleeve é uma das palavras mais úteis da Semana 4 para rotular e falar sobre detalhes.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é manga.

items.definition_en: The finished end part of a sleeve.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The end part of the sleeve.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte final da manga.
items.example_sentence_en: The cuff is at the end of the sleeve.
items.example_sentence_pt: O punho fica no final da manga.
items.professional_context_en: Cuff supports close observation of finished garment details.
items.professional_context_pt: Cuff ajuda na observação mais próxima de detalhes acabados da roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é punho.

items.definition_en: The upper body area where the sleeve joins the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The top side part where the sleeve begins.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte superior onde a manga começa.
items.example_sentence_en: The shoulder line is simple.
items.example_sentence_pt: A linha do ombro é simples.

items.professional_context_pt: Shoulder ajuda os alunos a relacionar detalhes da peça à observação de desenho e construção.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é ombro.

items.definition_en: The front side of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The side you see in the front.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O lado que aparece na frente.
items.example_sentence_en: The zipper is on the front.
items.example_sentence_pt: O zíper está na frente.
items.professional_context_en: Front is essential for location phrases in visual reading and detail description.
items.professional_context_pt: Front é essencial para frases de localização em leitura visual e descrição de detalhes.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é frente.

vocabulary_groups.title: Lower garment parts and closures
vocabulary_groups.description: Common visible lower-garment details and closure words for A2 description.

items.definition_en: The back side of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The side behind the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O lado de trás da peça.

items.professional_context_pt: Waistband oferece aos alunos uma palavra útil de estrutura para saias e calças.

items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é zíper.

items.definition_en: More than one button on a garment.

items.definition_en: A visible sewing mark or one unit of sewing.

items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma linha de costura ou um pequeno ponto de costura.

items.definition_en: A sewn fold that helps shape a garment.

items.example_sentence_en: The blouse has darts near the waist.

weeks.lesson_plan_markdown:
# Week 4: Parts of a Garment

## Overview
Week 4 builds directly from Week 3. Students already know common garment names and categories, so the new focus is on the visible parts and details of garments. The week stays visual, concrete, and A2-first. Students begin with a quick review of whole garments, learn a core garment-part vocabulary set, label one garment image, listen to short detail descriptions, practice reliable phrase frames, build a scaffolded Garment Details Card, review one correction target, and explain one garment in a teacher-supported speaking session.

The main artifact is not a paragraph. Instead, students complete a short structured Garment Details Card with required sentence-frame lines. This keeps the writing useful and professional without asking A2 learners for broad open production.

## Learning Objectives
- Recognize and name common visible garment parts in English.
- Match garment-part images to English vocabulary with Portuguese support when needed.
- Label visible details on a garment image using clear app-checkable choices.
- Understand short spoken descriptions of garment parts and locations.
- Use sentence frames such as `It has ___`, `There is a ___ on the front`, `There are ___ on the front`, and `The ___ is at the bottom`.
- Complete a short Garment Details Card using 5 to 6 required sentence-frame lines and one optional challenge line.
- Revise one sentence focused on singular and plural detail nouns or location phrases.
- Explain one garment in 4 to 6 short spoken sentences during the teacher session.

## Professional Fashion-Design Context
Garment-part vocabulary helps Fashion Design students move from naming a garment to observing and describing how it is made and how it looks. Students need this language for drawing, sewing, beginner patternmaking, technical observation, simple critique, and future portfolio captions.

Week 4 is especially useful because it introduces the language of visible details in an adult, professional context. Students are not only saying what the garment is. They are also naming parts, describing where those parts are, and beginning to comment on whether a detail is simple, decorative, or functional.

## Language Objectives
- Name garment parts such as `collar`, `neckline`, `sleeve`, `cuff`, `shoulder`, `pocket`, `zipper`, `button`, `waistband`, `hem`, `seam`, and `lining`.
- Use construction-detail words such as `pleat`, `dart`, and `stitch` at a beginner-accessible recognition level.
- Use location phrases such as `on the front`, `on the back`, `at the top`, `at the bottom`, `on the side`, and `near the hem`.
- Use controlled description words such as `visible`, `simple`, `decorative`, `functional`, `loose`, and `fitted`.
- Build accurate A2 detail-description sentences with `It has`, `They have`, `There is`, and `There are`.
- Improve singular and plural detail language such as `a collar`, `two pockets`, `buttons`, and `long sleeves`.

## Materials Needed
- One garment-detail overview board for the opener.
- Two garment-parts vocabulary boards with close-up detail visuals.
- One single garment image with visible label points for the visual-reading task.
- One reusable garment card or gallery set for listening, writing, and speaking support.
- One short audio clip or teacher read-aloud fallback for the listening task.
- Visible sentence frames for the Week 4 language focus.
- Student writing space for the Garment Details Card.

## Suggested Sequence
1. `m01w04-a01` Welcome Back: students review garment names and notice visible details.
2. `m01w04-a02` Garment Parts Vocabulary: students match garment-part images to English words and then use a short Portuguese bridge as support.
3. `m01w04-a03` Label the Garment: students inspect one garment image and choose labels and location phrases for marked points.
4. `m01w04-a04` Listen: students hear four short garment descriptions and choose the correct garment, detail, or location answer.
5. `m01w04-a05` Phrase Practice: students complete controlled frames with `It has`, `There is`, `There are`, and location phrases.
6. `m01w04-a06` Garment Details Card: students choose one garment and complete a structured detail card with required sentence frames.
7. `m01w04-a07` Review and Improve: students correct one common Week 4 sentence problem.
8. `m01w04-a08` Teacher Session: students practice pronunciation, label details live, and explain one garment using their card.

## Timing Estimate
- `m01w04-a01` 6 minutes
- `m01w04-a02` 14 minutes
- `m01w04-a03` 12 minutes
- `m01w04-a04` 12 minutes
- `m01w04-a05` 10 minutes
- `m01w04-a06` 18 minutes
- `m01w04-a07` 7 minutes
- `m01w04-a08` 50 minutes

Total planned time: 129 minutes.

The asynchronous or app-style portion is 79 minutes. The teacher-led speaking session is 50 minutes.

## Differentiation Options
- Keep the Week 4 garment images visible during vocabulary, labeling, listening, and writing.
- Let learners who need more support complete fewer choices at first, then retry with the full set.
- Provide a reduced word bank for the Garment Details Card if students need stronger support.
- Allow students to choose between a singular garment and a plural garment based on confidence.
- During speaking, allow learners to point to details on an image card while they speak.

## Extension Options
- Ask stronger learners to use the optional challenge line with `functional` or `decorative`, or to add one more sentence using `There are ___ near the ___`.
- Invite stronger learners to compare two garments with one short contrast sentence.
- In the teacher session, ask confident learners one follow-up question about where a detail is or why it is useful.

## Notes for Future App Implementation
Week 4 should stay image-first and detail-focused in a future app. The app-facing flow should preserve:

- one overview board for fast visual review
- two main image-word matching sets or boards as the primary saved vocabulary output
- one labeled garment task with explicit point keys and answer choices
- one listening task whose audio script matches the answer key exactly
- one phrase-practice task centered on fill-blank sentence frames, not mixed ambiguous outputs
- one teacher-reviewed structured writing card with separate sentence-frame fields instead of a blank paragraph box
- one teacher-observed speaking checkpoint that displays prompts and tracks completion without recording audio

The Week 4 garment-part set should stay reusable in later weeks about drawing, construction, fabric, technical description, and simple critique.
weeks.teacher_notes_markdown:
# Teacher Notes: Week 4 - Parts of a Garment

## Common Learner Difficulties
Students may confuse closely related words such as `collar` and `neckline`, or `seam` and `stitch`. They may also know the Portuguese idea but not understand which English word is used for the visible part and which word is used for the construction process. Another common problem is grammar: students may write `It has two pocket`, `There is buttons`, or `The hem is in the bottom` instead of the target Week 4 patterns.

## Classroom Management Suggestions
Keep the image support visible throughout the week. Students should not have to remember the detail vocabulary without visual reference at this stage. Move from recognition to production in a steady sequence: identify, label, listen, practice sentence frames, then write and speak. During the Garment Details Card, encourage students to complete one line at a time instead of trying to write freely.

## Professional Context Notes
Keep the week connected to real Fashion Design observation. Students are learning language for visible details they may draw, sew, label, describe, or discuss in class. This is not only clothing vocabulary. It is beginner technical language for talking about garment structure and visible design details.

## Cultural or Industry Notes
Some learners may already know fashion loanwords such as `zipper`, `lining`, or `fitted`, while other terms like `dart` and `pleat` may be new even in Portuguese-supported form. Treat those more technical words as image-supported recognition items first. Also remind students that some detail words are easier to understand when they are attached to one garment image instead of taught as abstract definitions.

## Simplify This Week
Reduce the Garment Details Card to exactly five required lines:
- This is a ___ / These are ___.
- It has ___ / They have ___.
- There is a ___ on the ___.
- The ___ is at the ___.
- I like this detail because ___.

For Activity 3, reduce the label set to six points instead of eight. In the speaking task, accept 3 to 4 short spoken sentences with strong teacher prompting if needed.

## Extend This Week
Ask stronger learners to use the optional challenge line with `functional` or `decorative`, or to add one more sentence using `There are ___ near the ___`. During the teacher session, invite a short follow-up question about whether a detail is useful, simple, or more decorative.

## Asynchronous or App-Based Adaptation
The opener, vocabulary matching, labeling task, listening task, phrase practice, and correction task can all be app-checked with immediate feedback. The Garment Details Card should remain teacher-visible because it is the main written artifact and benefits from a small revision cycle. The speaking checkpoint should remain teacher-observed and non-recorded, with the app serving only to display image cards, sentence frames, and completion notes.

I can match figure and sketch words to English words.
I can use Portuguese support when I need it without losing the English target.

success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar pontos de referência do corpo a palavras em inglês.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras de figura e croqui a palavras em inglês.
Eu consigo usar apoio em português quando preciso sem perder o foco no inglês.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on the two image-match sets. The Portuguese bridge and fill-blank sentence should come only after the main matching is complete.

input.prompt_en: Match the images to the correct English body and figure words.

items.label_en: Match the body-reference points to keys A to F.

Complete a frase.

steps.title: Look at the diagrams

steps.student_action_pt: Observe com atenção o diagrama de referência do corpo e o painel de figura e croqui e perceba as chaves visíveis antes de começar a relacionar.

steps.title: Match the main vocabulary sets

steps.student_action_pt: Relacione as chaves visíveis do painel do corpo e do painel de figura e croqui às palavras corretas em inglês.

O aluno relaciona elementos visuais do corpo e da figura a palavras em inglês.

activities.title: Label the Fashion Figure
activities.summary: Students practice figure labeling by matching body-reference words to explicit point keys on one front-view fashion figure.

en.title: Label the Fashion Figure
en.summary: Match the body words to the correct points on the figure.
en.instructions: Look at the front-view figure with point keys A to H. Match each body word to the correct point.
success_criteria: I can find the correct point on the fashion figure.
I can match body-reference words to visible keys.
I can use the figure image to check my answer.

pt.title: Rotule a figura de moda
pt.summary: Relacione as palavras do corpo aos pontos corretos da figura.
pt.instructions: Observe a figura em vista frontal com os pontos A até H. Relacione cada palavra do corpo ao ponto correto.
success_criteria: Eu consigo encontrar o ponto correto na figura de moda.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras de referência do corpo a chaves visíveis.
Eu consigo usar a imagem da figura para conferir minha resposta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task image-first. Students should use the visible A-H points rather than guessing from memory. Reinforce that the labels name reference points on a fashion figure, not general anatomy study.

input.prompt_en: Match each body-reference word to the correct point key on the figure.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione cada palavra de referência do corpo à chave de ponto correta na figura.

items.label_en: Match the body words to points A to H.
items.label_pt: Relacione as palavras do corpo aos pontos A até H.

steps.title: Look at the point keys
steps.student_action_en: Look at the figure and notice where points A to H are placed.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a figura e perceba onde os pontos A até H estão colocados.
steps.teacher_action: Point out that the same A-H keys appear in the task and the answer set.

steps.title: Match the labels
steps.student_action_en: Match each body-reference word to the correct point key.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione cada palavra de referência do corpo ao ponto correto.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to use the visible image instead of trying to answer from memory.

steps.title: Check the figure again
steps.student_action_en: Look at the image again and check whether each point word really matches the body location.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a imagem novamente e confira se cada palavra realmente corresponde ao local do corpo.
steps.teacher_action: Use this last step to reinforce waist versus hip if needed.

expected_output.description_en: A saved set of 8 label matches connecting body-reference words to points A to H on one fashion figure.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de 8 relações ligando palavras de referência do corpo aos pontos A até H em uma figura de moda.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the visible point keys.
The student matches the main body-reference words to the correct locations.
The student checks the image again before finishing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa as chaves de ponto visíveis.
O aluno relaciona as principais palavras de referência do corpo aos locais corretos.
O aluno observa a imagem novamente antes de terminar.
checklist_en: I looked at all the point keys.
I matched the body words carefully.
I checked the image again.
checklist_pt: Eu observei todas as chaves de ponto.
Eu relacionei as palavras do corpo com cuidado.

assessment.model_response_en: A head, B neck, C shoulder, D arm, E waist, F hip, G leg, and H foot
assessment.model_response_pt: A cabeça, B pescoço, C ombro, D braço, E cintura, F quadril, G perna e H pé
common_errors: Confusing waist and hip because both are in the middle body area.
Looking too quickly and matching the shoulder to the arm.
feedback_prompts_en: Look at the exact point again. Is it at the top of the body, the side, or lower down?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe o ponto exato novamente. Ele fica na parte de cima do corpo, na lateral ou mais abaixo?

support: Reduce the first attempt to six key labels, then add the remaining two labels.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one sentence aloud such as Point E is the waist.

extension_options: Add one more sentence using a body-reference word from the image.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one explicit point-key labeling activity. The image must visibly show points A-H, and the saved output must be the A-H matching set. Do not use hidden coordinate logic or unlabeled click targets.

activities.title: Listen: Describe the Pose
activities.summary: Students listen to four short figure descriptions and identify pose, view, garment, and silhouette details using the shared four-figure gallery.

en.title: Listen: Describe the Pose
en.summary: Listen to the figure descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Look at images A to D. Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer for each question.
success_criteria: I can match a spoken description to the correct figure image.
I can identify pose and view words in the audio.
I can hear one garment or silhouette detail.

pt.title: Escute: descreva a pose
pt.summary: Escute as descrições das figuras e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Observe as imagens A até D. Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto para cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar uma descrição falada à imagem correta da figura.
Eu consigo identificar palavras de pose e de vista no áudio.
Eu consigo ouvir um detalhe de roupa ou de silhueta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the four-figure gallery visible while students listen. The audio, question labels, answer keys, and model response should all use the same image A-D mapping.

input.prompt_en: Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem é o Número Um?

items.label_en: Which figure is in side view?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está em vista lateral?
O Número Três está caminhando.

items.label_en: Which figure has one hand on the hip?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está com uma mão no quadril?

items.label_en: Which figure is wearing a jacket and pants?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está vestindo jaqueta e calça?

steps.title: Look at the gallery
steps.student_action_en: Look at images A to D and notice the pose, view, and clothing in each one.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A até D e perceba a pose, a vista e a roupa em cada uma.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that the listening answers connect directly to the visible gallery, not to hidden information.

steps.title: Listen and choose

steps.student_action_pt: Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto em cada item.
steps.teacher_action: Allow replay and encourage students to listen for pose, view, and garment words.

steps.title: Check the image again
steps.student_action_en: Look at the gallery again and confirm why each answer matches the audio.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a galeria novamente e confirme por que cada resposta combina com o áudio.
steps.teacher_action: Use the final review to reinforce image A-D and the key listening phrases.

expected_output.description_en: Five listening selections identifying pose, view, and garment details from one audio clip using images A to D.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco seleções de escuta identificando pose, vista e detalhes da roupa a partir de um áudio usando as imagens A até D.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the shared four-figure gallery while listening.
The student identifies pose, view, and garment clues from the audio.
The student connects the spoken description to the correct image key.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa a galeria compartilhada de quatro figuras enquanto escuta.
O aluno identifica pistas de pose, vista e roupa no áudio.
O aluno relaciona a descrição falada à chave correta da imagem.
checklist_en: I looked at images A to D.

Eu escutei palavras de pose, vista e roupa.
Eu relacionei o áudio às chaves das imagens.

challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full reason after checking, such as Image B is correct because it is in side view.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one audio player plus the shared image A-D gallery. The app should allow replay, keep the image keys visible, and auto-check against the exact script-aligned answer key. Do not create or reference a separate transcript asset.

activities.title: Read: Sketch Captions
activities.summary: Students read four short sketch captions, match each one to the correct image in the shared four-figure gallery, and then answer one detail question.

en.title: Read: Sketch Captions
en.summary: Read the four short captions and match each one to the correct image.
en.instructions: Read the four short sketch captions. Match Caption A, B, C, and D to image A, B, C, or D, then answer the detail question.
success_criteria: I can match a short caption to the correct figure image.
I can identify pose, view, and garment words in reading.
I can find one detail answer in a short caption.

pt.title: Leia: legendas de croqui
pt.summary: Leia as quatro legendas curtas e relacione cada uma à imagem correta.
pt.instructions: Leia as quatro legendas curtas de croqui. Relacione as Legendas A, B, C e D à imagem A, B, C ou D e depois responda à pergunta de detalhe.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar uma legenda curta à imagem correta da figura.

input.prompt_en: Read the captions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia as legendas e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.

items.label_en: Caption B: This is a side-view sketch. The figure is wearing a jacket and pants. The pose is relaxed. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda B: This is a side-view sketch. The figure is wearing a jacket and pants. The pose is relaxed. Qual imagem combina?

items.label_en: Caption C: This is a walking croquis. The figure is wearing a blouse and a skirt. The silhouette is long and simple. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda C: This is a walking croquis. The figure is wearing a blouse and a skirt. The silhouette is long and simple. Qual imagem combina?

steps.title: Read the gallery first

steps.title: Read and match the captions

steps.title: Check the details
steps.student_action_en: Look back at the visible captions and confirm the final detail answer.
steps.student_action_pt: Volte às legendas visíveis e confirme a resposta final de detalhe.
steps.teacher_action: Use the last minute to reinforce that reading depends on matching words to visible evidence.

expected_output.description_en: Four caption-to-image matches plus one final reading-detail selection using the shared image A-D gallery.

completion_criteria_en: The student matches the captions to the visible gallery.

The student answers one final detail question from the visible captions.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno relaciona as legendas à galeria visível.
O aluno encontra evidências de pose, vista ou roupa nos textos curtos.
O aluno responde a uma pergunta final de detalhe a partir das legendas visíveis.
checklist_en: I looked at images A to D.
I matched the captions carefully.
I checked the final detail clue in the text.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens A até D.
Eu relacionei as legendas com atenção.
Eu conferi a pista final de detalhe no texto.
assessment.model_response_en: Caption A matches image A. Caption B matches image B. Caption C matches image C. Caption D matches image D. Caption C says the silhouette is long and simple.
assessment.model_response_pt: A Legenda A combina com a imagem A. A Legenda B combina com a imagem B. A Legenda C combina com a imagem C. A Legenda D combina com a imagem D. A Legenda C diz que a silhueta é longa e simples.
common_errors: Matching the right garment but missing the view word.
Reading the caption too fast and missing walking, one hand on the hip, or silhouette.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again for the strongest clue. Is it the view, the pose, the garment, or the silhouette phrase?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente a pista mais forte. É a vista, a pose, a roupa ou a frase sobre a silhueta?

support: Let students underline one clue word in each caption before answering.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence about why the image and the caption match.

extension_options: Choose one caption and rewrite one sentence using The figure is or The figure is wearing.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as four short visible caption cards plus the shared image A-D gallery. Save four caption-to-image selections and one final detail selection. Keep the visible image keys aligned with the listening task so students can transfer the same figure mapping across tasks.

activities.title: Phrase Practice: The Figure Is / The Figure Is Wearing

activities.title: Fashion Figure Description Card
activities.summary: Students produce the main Week 5 artifact by choosing one fashion figure and completing a short structured description card with required sentence-frame lines and one optional challenge line.

en.title: Fashion Figure Description Card
en.summary: Choose one figure and complete a short description card in English.
en.instructions: Choose one figure from images A to D. Complete the required lines about the image type, pose, view, garment, one detail, and the silhouette. Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
success_criteria: I can complete the required description lines.
I can use The figure is and The figure is wearing correctly.
I can describe one visible figure or garment feature in simple English.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.
Optional challenge: I like the pose because ___.

pt.title: Cartão de descrição da figura de moda
pt.summary: Escolha uma figura e complete um cartão curto de descrição em inglês.
pt.instructions: Escolha uma figura das imagens A até D. Complete as linhas obrigatórias sobre o tipo de imagem, a pose, a vista, a roupa, um detalhe e a silhueta. Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.
Eu consigo usar The figure is e The figure is wearing corretamente.
Eu consigo descrever uma característica visível da figura ou da roupa em inglês simples.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.
Desafio opcional: I like the pose because ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task structured and line-based. Do not turn it into a paragraph or a word-count task. Students should complete 5 to 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line only if ready.

input.prompt_en: Choose one figure from images A to D and complete the required description lines.

items.label_pt: Escolha a imagem da sua figura.

steps.title: Choose one figure

steps.title: Complete the required lines

steps.title: Add the optional challenge only if ready

expected_output.description_en: A saved Fashion Figure Description Card with 5 to 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.

Writing The figure is using a dress instead of The figure is wearing a dress.
Using the challenge line as if it were required.
Writing only a garment name without a full sentence frame.
feedback_prompts_en: Please add the missing be verb in one line.
Please change using to wearing for clothing.
Please make one detail line clearer.
Please revise one line and submit again.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Body Words and Adjective Order
activities.summary: Students review one common Week 5 sentence problem and save one corrected version they can transfer into the Fashion Figure Description Card.

en.title: Review and Improve: Body Words and Adjective Order
en.summary: Choose one correction card and write the improved sentence.
en.instructions: Choose one correction card, notice the problem, and write the corrected sentence clearly.
success_criteria: I can notice one common Week 5 sentence problem.
I can write one corrected sentence clearly.
I can use the correction to improve my description card.

pt.title: Revise e melhore: palavras do corpo e ordem dos adjetivos
pt.summary: Escolha um cartão de correção e escreva a frase melhorada.
pt.instructions: Escolha um cartão de correção, perceba o problema e escreva a frase corrigida com clareza.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um problema comum de frase da Semana 5.
Eu consigo escrever uma frase corrigida com clareza.
Eu consigo usar a correção para melhorar meu cartão de descrição.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep one narrow correction target per card. The goal is transfer back into the Week 5 description card, not broad grammar explanation.

input.prompt_en: Choose one Week 5 sentence and write the corrected version.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma frase da Semana 5 e escreva a versão corrigida.

items.label_pt: Corrija a falta do verbo be.
Corrija a expressão de roupa.
items.incorrect_sentence: The figure is using a dress.
items.correct_sentence: The figure is wearing a dress.
accepted_answers: The figure is wearing a dress.

items.label_en: Correct the article in the view phrase.
items.label_pt: Corrija o artigo na expressão de vista.
Corrija a ordem dos adjetivos.
items.correct_sentence: The silhouette is long and simple.
accepted_answers: The silhouette is long and simple.

steps.title: Choose a correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read one incorrect sentence and notice the correction focus.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia uma frase incorreta e perceba o foco da correção.
steps.teacher_action: Name the four main targets clearly: missing is, wearing, article in front view, and adjective order.

steps.title: Write the corrected sentence

steps.student_action_pt: Reescreva a frase com clareza e precisão.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to compare the corrected sentence with their own writing card.

steps.title: Transfer the correction

steps.student_action_pt: Confira se o mesmo problema aparece no seu próprio cartão de descrição.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to fix the same issue in their card if needed.

expected_output.description_en: One corrected Week 5 sentence saved after review.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma frase corrigida da Semana 5 salva após a revisão.

completion_criteria_en: The student chooses one correction card.
The student writes the corrected sentence accurately.
The student checks for the same issue in personal writing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno escolhe um cartão de correção.
O aluno escreve a frase corrigida com precisão.
O aluno verifica o mesmo problema na própria escrita.
checklist_en: I chose one correction card.
I wrote the corrected sentence.
I checked my own description card.
checklist_pt: Eu escolhi um cartão de correção.
Eu escrevi a frase corrigida.
Eu conferi meu próprio cartão de descrição.
assessment.model_response_en: The figure is wearing a dress.
assessment.model_response_pt: A figura está vestindo um vestido.
common_errors: Keeping the original mistake in the corrected sentence.
Fixing the word but forgetting the article or the verb.
feedback_prompts_en: Read the corrected model again. Which word or small grammar part changed?
feedback_prompts_pt: Leia o modelo corrigido novamente. Que palavra ou pequena parte gramatical mudou?

support: Limit the first attempt to two correction cards for students who need more support.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain the correction rule in simple English or Portuguese.

extension_options: Correct one more sentence from your own description card.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one small correction-card activity. Let the student choose one card, type or select the corrected version, and compare against accepted answers. Save one corrected sentence as the mini-revision artifact.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Sketch
activities.summary: Students use their Week 5 figure-description card to practice pronunciation, label body-reference points live, and describe one figure or sketch in short supported sentences.

en.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Sketch
en.summary: Use your card to describe one figure or sketch in short sentences.
en.instructions: Bring your Fashion Figure Description Card, practice the key words, and describe one figure or sketch in 4 to 6 short sentences.
success_criteria: I can name one figure or sketch clearly.
I can use pose, view, and garment language while speaking.
I can describe one visible feature with teacher support.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.

pt.title: Sessão com o professor: descreva um croqui
pt.summary: Use o seu cartão para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em frases curtas.
pt.instructions: Leve o seu Cartão de Descrição da Figura de Moda, pratique as palavras principais e descreva uma figura ou um croqui em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo nomear uma figura ou um croqui com clareza.
Eu consigo usar linguagem de pose, vista e roupa ao falar.
Eu consigo descrever uma característica visível com apoio do professor.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep this teacher-observed only. Do not record student audio. Focus on intelligibility, accurate Week 5 frames, and confidence with a short supported description rather than long performance.

input.prompt_en: Use your Fashion Figure Description Card to describe one figure or sketch in short sentences.
input.prompt_pt: Use o seu Cartão de Descrição da Figura de Moda para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em frases curtas.

items.label_en: Say 4 to 6 short sentences about one figure or sketch.
items.label_pt: Diga de 4 a 6 frases curtas sobre uma figura ou um croqui.

items.label_en: Include pose, view, garment, and one visible feature.
items.label_pt: Inclua pose, vista, roupa e uma característica visível.

steps.title: Pronunciation clinic
steps.student_action_en: Practice key Week 5 words such as figure, sketch, croquis, outline, silhouette, shoulder, waist, hip, and knee.
steps.student_action_pt: Pratique palavras importantes da Semana 5 como figure, sketch, croquis, outline, silhouette, shoulder, waist, hip e knee.
steps.teacher_action: Model the words slowly and clearly, especially croquis, silhouette, shoulder, and proportion.

steps.title: Label the figure live
steps.student_action_en: Look at the shared figure or gallery and say the main body-reference points.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a figura compartilhada ou a galeria e diga os principais pontos de referência do corpo.
steps.teacher_action: Use quick pointing and naming before the full speaking turn.

steps.title: Describe one sketch
steps.student_action_en: Use your Week 5 card to describe one figure or sketch in 4 to 6 short sentences.
steps.student_action_pt: Use o seu cartão da Semana 5 para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
steps.teacher_action: Allow students to read from their card first, then invite a more natural second try when appropriate.

steps.title: Wrap up and preview
steps.student_action_en: Listen to classmates and prepare for next week’s focus on color, shape, and line.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute os colegas e prepare-se para o foco da próxima semana em cor, forma e linha.
steps.teacher_action: Close with one short review of The figure is, The figure is wearing, and the main Week 5 visual words.

expected_output.description_en: A short teacher-observed spoken description of one fashion figure or sketch using Week 5 sentence frames.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma descrição oral curta, observada pelo professor, de uma figura de moda ou croqui usando as estruturas da Semana 5.

vocabulary_groups.title: Basic body reference points
vocabulary_groups.description: Core body-reference words students need for labeling and simple fashion-figure observation.

items.definition_en: The top part of the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The top body part with the face and hair.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte de cima do corpo com o rosto e o cabelo.
items.example_sentence_en: The head is at the top of the figure.
items.example_sentence_pt: A cabeça fica na parte de cima da figura.
items.professional_context_en: Students use head to label body-reference points on a fashion figure.
items.professional_context_pt: Os alunos usam head para rotular pontos de referência do corpo em uma figura de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é cabeça.

items.definition_en: The body part between the head and the shoulders.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The part between the head and the shoulders.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte entre a cabeça e os ombros.
items.example_sentence_en: The neckline is near the neck.
items.example_sentence_pt: O decote fica perto do pescoço.
items.professional_context_en: Neck helps students connect the figure to garment details such as collar and neckline.
items.professional_context_pt: Neck ajuda os alunos a relacionar a figura a detalhes da roupa, como gola e decote.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é pescoço.

items.definition_en: The upper side part of the body where the arm begins.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The top side part where the arm starts.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte de cima e lateral onde o braço começa.
items.example_sentence_en: The sleeves start at the shoulders.
items.example_sentence_pt: As mangas começam nos ombros.
items.professional_context_en: Shoulder is useful for describing both the body line and garment fit.
items.professional_context_pt: Shoulder é útil para descrever tanto a linha do corpo quanto o caimento da roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é ombro.

items.definition_en: The upper body part from the shoulder to the hand.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The body part from the shoulder to the hand.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do corpo que vai do ombro até a mão.
items.example_sentence_en: The arms are relaxed in this pose.
items.example_sentence_pt: Os braços estão relaxados nesta pose.
items.professional_context_en: Arm helps students describe pose and movement in fashion figures.
items.professional_context_pt: Arm ajuda os alunos a descrever pose e movimento em figuras de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é braço.

items.definition_en: The middle joint of the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The arm joint in the middle.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A articulação no meio do braço.
items.example_sentence_en: The elbow is bent in the walking pose.
items.example_sentence_pt: O cotovelo está dobrado na pose de caminhada.
items.professional_context_en: Elbow supports careful observation of arm position in figure drawing.
items.professional_context_pt: Elbow ajuda na observação cuidadosa da posição do braço no desenho da figura.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é cotovelo.

items.definition_en: The body part at the end of the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The body part at the end of the arm with fingers.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do corpo no fim do braço com os dedos.
items.example_sentence_en: One hand is on the hip.
items.example_sentence_pt: Uma mão está no quadril.
items.professional_context_en: Hand is useful for describing simple pose details in fashion figures.
items.professional_context_pt: Hand é útil para descrever detalhes simples de pose em figuras de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é mão.

items.definition_en: The middle body area above the hips.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The middle part of the body above the hips.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do meio do corpo acima dos quadris.
items.example_sentence_en: The skirt starts at the waist.
items.example_sentence_pt: A saia começa na cintura.
items.professional_context_en: Waist is a body-reference point and should stay separate from waistband in Week 4.
items.professional_context_pt: Waist é um ponto de referência do corpo e deve ficar separado de waistband da Semana 4.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use cintura para o corpo, não cós.

items.definition_en: The side area below the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The side body area below the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A área lateral do corpo abaixo da cintura.
items.example_sentence_en: The hand is on the hip.
items.example_sentence_pt: A mão está no quadril.
items.professional_context_en: Hip helps learners connect pose, body line, and garment placement.
items.professional_context_pt: Hip ajuda os alunos a relacionar pose, linha do corpo e posição da roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é quadril.

items.definition_en: The lower body part from the hip to the foot.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The body part from the hip to the foot.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do corpo que vai do quadril até o pé.
items.example_sentence_en: The legs are long in this sketch.
items.example_sentence_pt: As pernas são longas neste croqui.
items.professional_context_en: Leg supports basic proportion and pose description in figure drawing.
items.professional_context_pt: Leg ajuda na descrição básica de proporção e pose no desenho da figura.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é perna.

items.definition_en: The middle joint of the leg.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The leg joint in the middle.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A articulação no meio da perna.
items.example_sentence_en: The hem is below the knee.

items.professional_context_pt: Knee é especialmente útil para a linguagem de comprimento da roupa, como acima do joelho e abaixo do joelho.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é joelho.

items.definition_en: The body part at the end of the leg.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The body part at the end of the leg.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do corpo no fim da perna.
items.example_sentence_en: The foot is at the bottom of the figure.
items.example_sentence_pt: O pé fica na parte de baixo da figura.

items.professional_context_pt: Foot completa o conjunto básico de rótulos para diagramas de figura.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use pé no singular para as tarefas de rótulo.

vocabulary_groups.title: Figure, sketch, and croquis words
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words students need for beginner fashion-figure and sketch description.

items.definition_en: A drawn or represented body in a sketch.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The drawn body in a fashion sketch.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O corpo desenhado em um croqui de moda.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is standing.
items.example_sentence_pt: A figura está em pé.
items.professional_context_en: Figure is the main Week 5 word for the drawn body in fashion observation.
items.professional_context_pt: Figure é a principal palavra da Semana 5 para o corpo desenhado na observação de moda.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use figura para o corpo desenhado ou representado.

items.definition_en: The person or represented figure wearing the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The person or figure wearing the clothes.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A pessoa ou figura que está vestindo a roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The model is wearing a jacket and pants.
items.example_sentence_pt: A modelo está vestindo uma jaqueta e uma calça.
items.professional_context_en: Model is useful as a support word alongside figure in sketch description.
items.professional_context_pt: Model é útil como palavra de apoio junto com figure na descrição do croqui.
items.translation_notes_pt: Pode ser modelo, mas mantenha o foco na função da figura no desenho.

items.definition_en: A quick drawing that shows an idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A simple drawing of an idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um desenho simples de uma ideia.

items.example_sentence_pt: Este esboço é simples e claro.

items.definition_en: A fashion sketch of the figure used in design work.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A fashion drawing of the figure.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um desenho de moda da figura.
items.example_sentence_en: This croquis has a long silhouette.
items.example_sentence_pt: Este croqui tem uma silhueta longa.

items.translation_notes_pt: Explique como croqui ou fashion sketch.

items.definition_en: The outside line or contour of the figure or garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The outside line of the drawing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A linha de fora do desenho.
items.example_sentence_en: The outline is simple.
items.example_sentence_pt: O contorno é simples.
items.professional_context_en: Outline helps students notice the visible outer shape of a sketch.
items.professional_context_pt: Outline ajuda os alunos a perceber a forma externa visível de um croqui.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é contorno.

items.definition_en: The position of the figure.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: How the figure is standing, walking, or sitting.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Como a figura está em pé, andando ou sentada.
items.example_sentence_en: The pose is relaxed.
items.example_sentence_pt: A pose é relaxada.
items.professional_context_en: Pose is central to Week 5 because students need it for observation drawing language.
items.professional_context_pt: Pose é central na Semana 5 porque os alunos precisam dela para a linguagem de desenho de observação.
items.translation_notes_pt: A palavra pose também é muito usada em português.

items.definition_en: The relation of one body part to another in the drawing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: How body parts compare in size or length in the drawing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Como as partes do corpo se relacionam em tamanho ou comprimento no desenho.
items.example_sentence_en: The proportion is stylized in this croquis.
items.example_sentence_pt: A proporção é estilizada neste croqui.
items.professional_context_en: Proportion should stay light and observational at this level.
items.professional_context_pt: Proportion deve ficar leve e observacional neste nível.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é proporção.

items.definition_en: The overall shape of the figure and garment together.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The general outside shape you see.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A forma geral externa que você vê.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette is long and simple.
items.example_sentence_pt: A silhueta é longa e simples.
items.professional_context_en: Silhouette is a key Fashion Design word that connects the figure to the garment shape.
items.professional_context_pt: Silhouette é uma palavra-chave de Design de Moda que liga a figura à forma da roupa.
items.translation_notes_pt: A tradução mais comum é silhueta.
